name: ug-corporate-income-tax
description: Uganda corporate income tax for companies and branches, tax year 2026-27: the 30% rate, withholding on dividends, interest, royalties and fees, the 2026 changes on interest caps, arm's length, hotels and bad debts, provisional tax and the annual return. Use for Uganda questions from URA taxpayers, employers, advisers and foreign investors, including rates, thresholds, filing dates, the URA portal and worked computations. Figures for tax year 2026-27 come from Uganda Revenue Authority pages and the law, and items that could not be opened are named as unverified in the Sources section. Not reviewed by a licensed accountant.
